title: Finite typed completed-operation expressions and substitution
statement: Let $S,I$ be sets, $W_a$ a scheme for each $a\in S$ [def-pc-scheme], and $s:I\to S$ an assignment of input locations. A finite typed operation expression of output $a$ is inductively an input $i$ (output $s(i)$), a coefficient unit $1_a$, a binary tensor of two expressions of output $a$, or the pullback of an expression of output $b$ along a scheme map $W_a\to W_b$. Each expression is finite; the sets of available schemes and inputs may be arbitrary, including empty, and inputs may repeat. Given another input-location function $s':J\to S$ and expressions $\sigma_i$ of output $s(i)$ in that context, simultaneous substitution replaces input $i$ by $\sigma_i$, fixes units, and recurses through tensor and pullback, preserving all parentheses and output types.
